Definition: from G1537 and G3992; to despatch:--send away (forth).
BiblicalUsage: The word ekpémpō carries the sense of to send away, to send forth. In Acts 13:4, the text says "being sent forth by the Holy Ghost."
TheologicalSignificance: I read ekpémpō plainly — it means to send away, to send forth, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Elymas Blinded on Cyprus; Paul at Berea
